items.text: Green Bay FINAL: OUT - EDGE Micah Parsons (knee/PUP), LB Zaire Franklin (shin), G Sean Rhyan (ankle), OL Travis Glover (knee), TE Josh Whyle (concussion). Questionable - CB Keisean Nixon (groin), RB Chris Brooks (ankle), RB MarShawn Lloyd (knee). Jordan Love starts.

New England FINAL: OUT - WR A.J. Brown (ankle/knee), RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness). Questionable - TE Hunter Henry (foot), OT Morgan Moses (foot), CB Carlton Davis III (neck), S Kevin Byard (chest), OL Greg Van Roten, WR Mack Hollins, S Brenden Schooler. Drake Maye starts. WR Romeo Doubs, G Mike Onwenu on IR.
